instruction: Three Zone Clinic Completion. Work in the opened OpenStudio application, starting from the Desktop input file init.osm. The init.osm model is a relevant predecessor with placeholder space names and missing final zone HVAC equipment lists. In OpenStudio, assign the required space names, create or restore the required zone HVAC equipment lists, and verify the required Reception, Exam, and Storage spaces, story and zone assignments, paired internal Surface boundary conditions, and target geometry. Complete the model, then save result.osm in the task output folder. The completed model must contain 1 building story, 3 spaces and 3 thermal zones. Use these exact OS:Space names: Exam, Reception and Storage. Every space must be assigned to a building story and a thermal zone, and each space must have more than 0.05 m2 of floor area. Model the enclosure with 19 OS:Surface objects, split into 3 floor surfaces, 3 roof/ceiling surfaces and 13 wall surfaces. The surface outside-boundary counts should be 3 Ground, 10 Outdoors and 6 Surface. Do not add any windows or other subsurfaces. Include 0 ideal-loads air systems, 3 zone HVAC equipment lists and 0 dual-setpoint thermostats. Set the geometry so the overall surface-geometry bounding box spans 10.00 m in X, 6.00 m in Y and 3.20 m in Z, each within +/-0.10 m. The total floor surface area should be 60.00 m2 within +/-0.75 m2 and the total exterior wall gross area should be 102.40 m2 within +/-0.75 m2. Other model details may vary as long as the saved OSM satisfies these stated requirements.
